nextCursor.description: seq of the last event returned, to pass as afterSeq. It can be present on the last page; stop when `data` is empty.

context.description: Override context for the cloned run

tags.description: Override tags for the cloned run

CommitmentProjection.description: Section 3 projection of the Commitment: the exact field set the hash covers, in snake_case.

CommitmentSupersedes.description: Cross-session commitment supersession (RFC-MACP-0001 §7.3, macp-proto 0.1.3). Points at the prior commitment this one replaces. Observed-only — the control-plane surfaces it for insight UIs; it does not resolve the chain.

canonical.description: Derived (RFC-MACP-0013 §9): true when `commitmentHash` matches the canonical shape a ≥0.7.0 runtime enforces on accept — the literal prefix `sha256:` followed by exactly 64 lowercase hex characters. Against such a runtime every *accepted* commitment is canonical by construction; `false` marks a legacy/malformed value observed in pre-0013 replayed history. This is observed-only — the control-plane never rejects or drops a non-canonical hash, it only badges it.

leftRunId.description: UUID of the left run to compare.

rightRunId.description: UUID of the right run to compare.

sessionId.description: Control-plane-allocated (or echoed back) session id the initiator agent must open.

events.description: Events to subscribe to. Empty = all events.

secret.description: Secret used for HMAC-SHA256 signature verification. Write-only: never returned; responses carry `hasSecret` instead.

url.description: URL to receive webhook POST requests

supersedes.description: Set when the finalized commitment supersedes a prior one (cross-session).

implicit.description: True when this contribution is a runtime-emitted **synthetic** HandoffAccept (`HandoffAcceptPayload.implicit`, RFC-MACP-0010 §5.1) — the target never explicitly accepted; the runtime auto-accepted on the implicit-accept timer. The console badges these distinctly from real accepts. Absent for all other contributions. Corroborated by a `message_id` prefixed `implicit-accept:`.

receiptJson.description: The runtime's receipt JSON text, verbatim. Verify signatures over THIS, never a re-serialization.

ErrorResponse.description: Every error body (GlobalExceptionFilter). `errorCode` is set by control-plane errors and absent on Nest built-in errors, which carry `error` instead; `message` is a list for request-validation failures.

error.description: HTTP reason phrase, on Nest built-in errors.

errorCode.description: One of the ErrorCode values (filled in at export).

EventSourceKind.description:
Origin plane of a canonical event. `macp-control-plane` denotes events synthesized by this service (run lifecycle, recovery, observability) as opposed to `runtime` (forwarded from the Rust runtime) or `replay`.

The value was historically `'control-plane'`; it was renamed to the fully-qualified `'macp-control-plane'` on the wire. Use  {@link  normalizeEventSourceKind }  when reading values that may predate the rename so legacy rows project under the canonical value.

ExpectedCommitment.description: Populated on the `policy.expectedCommitments[]` projection when (future) runtime `PolicyResolved` events supply commitment expectations. Not part of the inbound HTTP contract — the control-plane does not accept commitments from callers.

id.description: Bare sender string — must match the agent identity in the runtime.

PolicyDenyDetails.description: A runtime policy denial's structured detail — the JSON the runtime writes to `MACPError.details` and the `macp-error-details-bin` status trailer: `{ reasons: string[], denials: [{ code, message, participants }] }` (macp-runtime `error_details_bytes`; `denials` since v0.9.0).

speed.description: Playback speed multiplier for timed replay.

historyGap.description: True when the control-plane could not resume the per-session StreamSession from its last envelope ordinal because that history was compacted away (runtime FAILED_PRECONDITION). Some envelope-level events between the compacted base and reconnect may be missing from this run's event log; the console surfaces this as a fidelity warning. Set by T7's gap handler.

maxSuspendMs.description: Resolved cap (ms) on cumulative suspended time before a SUSPENDED session expires (RFC-MACP-0001 §7.5), read from the decoded SessionStart payload (`max_suspend_ms`). Absent when the session start carried 0/none.

commitmentHash.description: RFC-MACP-0013 hash of the CommitmentPayload as the control plane stored it (what the UI shows).

notVerified.description: What this endpoint does not establish, so a reader does not over-read a green result.

recomputed.description: RFC-MACP-0013 hash recomputed from the Commitment envelope's raw payload bytes, decoded afresh.

wireVerdict.description: RFC-MACP-0013 §6.1 verdict of the stored wire bytes against `commitmentHash`.

rules.description: Parsed policy rules object (RFC-MACP-0012 per-mode schema: voting, objection_handling, evaluation, commitment for decision; threshold, abstention, commitment for quorum; etc.)

schemaVersion.description: Policy schema version. 1 and 2 are fail-open on an empty decisive tally; 3 is fail-closed (default for new policies, RFC-MACP-0012 §3).

missingFromRuntime.description: null when the runtime session list was truncated (not computed).

contextId.description: SessionMetadata.context_id (field 12) — the SessionStart context_id, preserved verbatim.

extensionKeys.description: SessionMetadata.extension_keys (field 13) — keys of the SessionStart extensions map.

metadata.description: Opaque metadata. Reserved keys: source, sourceRef, environment, scenarioRef, cancelCallback, cancellationDelegated.

sessionId.description: Caller-allocated session id. Must satisfy the runtime validator: at most 128 bytes, and a lowercase UUID v4/v7 or a base64url token of 22+ chars. If omitted, control-plane allocates a UUID v4.

senderAuthenticated.description: `signal.emitted.data.senderAuthenticated` (runtime v0.9.0): `true` only when the runtime authenticated the sender. `false` in dev-mode auth and on pre-0.9.0 runtimes; absent on projections built before the field existed. Treat only `true` as verified.

secret.description: HMAC-SHA256 signing secret. Write-only: never returned; responses carry `hasSecret` instead.

VerificationStatus.description: `verified` — every check passed. `mismatch` — a check that could run disagreed. `cannot_verify` — the Commitment exists but its wire bytes are outside what the label covers (RFC-MACP-0013 §5/§6.1) or are not stored. `pending` — the run has no Commitment (yet).

VerifyOutcome.description: Result of  {@link  verifyCommitmentHash }  (RFC-MACP-0013 §6.1). `cannot_verify` is a verdict on the payload encoding — never on the claim.

WebhookView.description:
A webhook subscription as the API returns it (#140).

The HMAC signing secret is write-only: it is accepted on create and update, used to sign deliveries, and never returned. `hasSecret` says whether one is stored.

events.description: Event types the subscription receives. Empty = all events.

hasSecret.description: True when a signing secret is stored. The secret itself is never returned.

mode.description: Policy mode. Defaults to the run's session mode; `*` replays a wildcard policy.

policyId.description: Echoed back as `candidatePolicyId`; need not be registered.

rules.description: Candidate rules, the same shape `POST /runtime/policies` accepts. Never registered.

bearer.description: One of the keys in AUTH_API_KEYS, as `Authorization: Bearer <key>` (the bare key is also accepted). When AUTH_API_KEYS is empty, auth is disabled (development only).
